problem: The BB-004 headless test/data command exists but is not yet executed automatically by GitHub Actions, so test/data failures would not produce a CI failure signal on every pull request and main update.

decision.rationale: Add a read-only pull_request/push workflow that checks out the exact candidate/source revision, installs the pinned Java major and required Linux headless runtime library, and invokes the canonical BB-004 test command. Keep trusted pull_request_target evidence policy unchanged so candidate test code never becomes the authority for governance validation.

research.candidate_pool_exception: Shipped-product research is not applicable to CI wiring.
research.reference_exception: This process change has no player-facing behavior.

anti_pattern.observation: Using a privileged pull_request_target workflow to execute untrusted candidate code expands the trust boundary.
anti_pattern.lesson: Run candidate test code under pull_request with read-only permissions and leave the trusted evidence workflow separate.

official_docs.verified_constraint: pull_request workflows are appropriate for testing proposed changes, while pull_request_target has a different trust/security model and should not execute untrusted candidate code.
Workflow permissions can be restricted to read-only contents and jobs can run on pull_request and push events.
Workflow artifacts can retain generated test reports and logs after the job completes.

alternatives.reason: Keeps runtime test execution on exact candidate source with read-only permissions while preserving the trusted evidence-policy boundary unchanged.
Executing candidate runtime/test code from pull_request_target would unnecessarily expand the privileged trust boundary and mix governance authority with candidate execution.
Repository standards is a lightweight static gate; coupling a Defold headless build into it would blur responsibilities and make standards failures slower to diagnose.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every pull request and main push gets an explicit test/data CI job using the exact source revision.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: .github/workflows/test-data.yml triggers on pull_request and push to main and checks out github.event.pull_request.head.sha or github.sha with persisted credentials disabled.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The CI job invokes the same canonical BB-004 command developers use locally and propagates its non-zero exit status.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The workflow installs OpenJDK 25 plus libopenal1 and runs `bash scripts/test.sh` directly under shell failure semantics. The missing OpenAL runtime was exposed by the first CI execution and fixed rather than bypassed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Test reports/logs are retained for diagnosis without granting write permissions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The workflow declares contents: read and uploads build/test-results plus build/reports/tests.json with the repository's pinned upload-artifact action.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing trusted PR evidence validation remains separate and unchanged while source-of-truth docs advance only after BB-004 proof.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: pr-evidence-trusted.yml and policy scripts are not modified. README.md and docs/06-production-roadmap.md record BB-004 complete and hand off to BB-005 after exact stacked runtime proof passed 11/11.

automated: Exact stacked candidate 7c3aefb8112fd1385ddeeec760b3aa27b32548e2 completed the new headless test/data job with BB-004 tests: PASS (11/11) and retained artifact 9700371425.
The final PR head must repeat Repository standards, Test and data, and trusted-base evidence/trust-boundary validation before merge.
verification.runtime_errors: The first CI execution correctly failed because Ubuntu lacked libopenal.so.1. Installing libopenal1 resolved the environment dependency; the subsequent exact stacked run completed 11/11. The final PR head is required to repeat the same proof before merge.

governance.trust_boundary_change: Adds a new unprivileged candidate-source CI workflow. It has contents: read, runs under pull_request/push, and does not modify the existing pull_request_target trusted evidence workflow, ruleset authority or policy code. README/roadmap changes are status closeout only.
governance.bypass_analysis: Candidate branches can edit their own tests/workflow, so this job is intentionally not a governance authority and does not replace validate-pr-evidence. Its role is deterministic runtime/data regression detection. The trusted-base policy continues to classify and validate the candidate diff independently.
governance.rollback: Delete .github/workflows/test-data.yml and revert the BB-004 status handoff if the workflow must be removed. No production runtime code, secrets, ruleset or trusted evidence policy depends on the workflow.

known_limitations: The workflow is a CI regression signal; the repository's existing required ruleset check remains validate-pr-evidence unless separately changed through an explicit ruleset governance task.
BB-005 still owns the broader PR HTML5 playable artifact contract.
